statement: US raised import tariffs, and China and others retaliated with tariffs on US goods
quote: The United States has announced changes to its trade policy, including increased tariffs on imports. These actions have caused substantial uncertainty and have resulted in retaliatory measures, including new tariffs on U.S. goods imposed by China and other countries.

statement: China imposed export controls on rare earth minerals used in AMAT products in 2025

statement: Countries implementing OECD global minimum tax rules, effective from fiscal 2025

statement: AI and other end markets are driving the next wave of industry growth
